objective: Route requests across local models by latency, risk, and reasoning depth.

primary.name: qwen2.5:7b
primary.comment: Default reasoning is the LIGHT 7b — fast and kind to the machine (the 14b pinned ~15 GB of RAM on a 32 GB laptop and made everyday chat slow + the whole system drag; Vera must be a catalyst, not a tax). 7b handles everyday low-risk turns well; genuinely complex or high-risk turns escalate to the 14b deepPlanner on demand (Ollama loads it only then, unloads when idle). Battery-saver drops further to the 3b fastFallback. This delivers 'powerful without being heavy by default'. Device-aware: device_model may pick an even smaller default on low-RAM machines.

deepPlanner.name: qwen2.5:7b
deepPlanner.comment: Deeper planning uses the 7B (the 14B was removed — it pinned ~15 GB and made the machine drag; the 7B is plenty for a local companion+agent). Everyday turns use the same 7B; genuinely complex turns still route here but without the heavy cost. Light by default, powerful enough.

companion.name: vera-merged:latest
companion.comment: Emotional / check-in / reflective turns route to OUR OWN trained model — vera-merged: our LoRA-fine-tuned conversation weights merged with Empathia's companion doctrine + warm sampling params. This is the model that makes Vera *hers*; light (3B), on-device, warm + present, and it passes the conversation+crisis eval. Falls back to empathia-tiny-opt / qwen if it isn't installed (see device_model._VERA_MODELS and _choose_fallback). If it drifts to 'shall I list your tasks?', fix the model/persona — companionship IS the point.

routingRules.comment: Emotional / check-in / companionship turns go to the warm Empatheia model — the 'companion' hat. Reasoning, planning, and VS Code drive never route here.
Device constraints win first — a throttled/low-battery device must not run the big model.
Any high-risk request gets the careful planner, regardless of how short it is.
Complex planning, even at lower risk, benefits from the deeper model.
Everything else — quick, low-risk asks — goes to the default model.
Catch-all so nothing ever falls through unrouted.
